user.title: AR Motion AI
user.description: Take camera snapshots when motion is detected, have an AI describe them and push the result to your phones. Next step: connect the AI provider.

data.name: Name
data.notify_on_no_motion: Notify even when the AI sees nothing

data_description.notify_services: Pick mobile_app_* services (works for Android and iOS). Leave empty to only update entities/events.
data_description.prompt: Jinja is supported. Variables: camera_name, trigger. Keep the 'no obvious motion' phrase so empty results can be filtered.
data_description.cooldown_seconds: Motion triggers inside this window are ignored.
data_description.provider: Gemini has a free tier. OpenAI and Claude need credit on their account. Ollama is free and runs locally. 'Home Assistant AI Task' uses an AI integration you already set up in HA.

data_description.api_key: Gemini: aistudio.google.com/apikey · OpenAI: platform.openai.com/api-keys · Claude: console.anthropic.com
data_description.base_url: Ollama: http://<host>:11434 · OpenAI-compatible: base URL ending in /v1 (e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1)

model.title: Choose a model
model.description: Found {count} models on your account. The pre-selected one is a cheap, fast vision model. You can also type a model name.

error.no_sensors: Select at least one motion sensor.
error.invalid_auth: API key rejected. Check the key and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the AI server. Check the URL and your network.
error.no_credit: This account has no credit. Add billing on the provider's site, or choose another provider (Gemini has a free tier).
error.rate_limited: Rate limited / free quota used up. Wait a bit and try again.
